title: dnd-5e-2024 background stats (docs/rulesets.md#backgrounds)
description: Stored inputs only; a background derives nothing. Cross-field and cross-entry rules are checks in checks.ts (docs/rulesets.md#consistency-checks).

abilities.description: The three ability scores the background raises, printed "Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma".

feat.description: The origin feat it grants, printed with "(see “Feats”)" after it.

skills.description: The two skill proficiencies, printed "Insight and Religion".

tool.description: The tool proficiency: a tool, or with `choose`, one kind of a tool with variants or a group ("Choose one kind of Gaming Set").

choose.description: Prints "Choose one kind of" before the name.
